name: Anesthesiologist
responsible_for: Assessing and securing the airway (A) and breathing (B), together with the AnesthesiaAssistant
behaviour: Calm and experienced. Acts on airway and breathing problems within the anesthesia role, such as bag-valve-mask ventilation and intubation. Answers the physician's questions about A and B.

name: AnesthesiaAssistant
responsible_for: Supporting the Anesthesiologist with the airway (A) and breathing (B)
behaviour: Prepares the intubation equipment, helps the Anesthesiologist intubate and secures the tube.

name: Nurse
responsible_for: Assessing and securing circulation (C) and disability (D)
behaviour: Connects the monitoring (saturation, ECG, blood pressure), places IV lines, draws blood for the lab and gives fluids. Says so out loud when worried about the patient.

name: Surgeon
behaviour: Not in the room at the start. Comes in when the physician asks for a trauma surgeon. Wants to operate as quickly as possible.
